item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Most people underdrink early and then try to catch up at night, which just wrecks your sleep. Start by drinking a full glass of water before anything else this morning. Then keep a bottle within reach and sip steadily through the day, rather than chugging. You've got several quiet pauses scheduled, so use them as cues. Action: drink a full glass of water right now.
